visual_audit_fixes.note: Post-audit fix pass for the 9 confirmed Phase-C visual findings. Every fix re-verified in this sandbox: node --check clean; boot-check PASS at 760/1280/2500 (13 routes each); matrix suite 89/89 across all 8 themes x 760/1280/2500; managers suite 49/49.

fixes.what: Shell titlebar page-tab clipping at 760 (friendly themes: 'Usage' cut to 'Us', 'Settings' dropped). Concept CSS now gives .pm-page-tabs min-width:0/overflow:hidden and each .pm-page-tab min-width:0 + ellipsis, with the active tab flex-shrink:0. Verified: all six tabs ellipsize within the wrap at 760 in friendly-dark and friendly-light; active Settings tab renders whole.

Chapter rail 'Extensio...' truncation in glass and basic themes at every width. The spine is now font-tolerant: shrink-to-fit width (min 148px, max 244px) inside a new .c09-spine-wrap, so each theme's font sets the rail measure; the label ellipsis was replaced by a clip-with-3px-pad because the widest label defines the intrinsic width and LayoutUnit rounding of that exact equality rendered a spurious ellipsis. Verified: all 12 chapter labels render in full at 1280 and 2500 in glass-dark/glass-light/basic-dark/basic-light (probe: zero truncated labels; screenshots re-eyeballed).

Narrow top chapter strip hard-clipped mid-glyph at the right viewport edge with no affordance. The wrap now carries scroll-position-driven edge-fade masks (has-left/has-right classes from a scroll listener; masks sit on the non-scrolling wrap so they stay pinned). Verified by pixel sampling retro-dark/retro-light 760: glyph contrast decays to background across the final 34px (previously full-contrast glyph pixels at x=759), and the classes flip when scrolled to either end.

AI Providers action wall (9 buttons) with the Ollama ownership caption breaking the grid. Any inline unavailable action now renders as one bordered card (button + reason together) so captions can never interleave between unrelated buttons. Resolved centrally: _shared2/pm2-tokens.css now drops whole trailing tabs below 1000px instead of ellipsizing, and always keeps the active tab intact. visual_audit_fixes_round3.note: Third-round independent-audit pass: 6 confirmed minors on concept-09 (one flagged as a regression from the unaudited 'quiet at all widths' change in the shared token layer), plus one functional defect found while proving the regression fix by scrolling. All seven are fixed inside concept-09-tome-tabs.css / .js only - nothing in _shared/, _shared2/, tools/, the hub, or any .html was touched. Re-verified in this sandbox (headless Chromium over file:// via tools/harness/cdp.js) AFTER the edits: node --check clean; tools/boot-check.js PASS at 760 / 900 / 1280 / 2500 (13 routes each, zero console errors or warnings, no overflow); harness matrix 113/113, state 17/17, managers 49/49 for concept-09. Every number below was measured, not projected.

fixes.what: The fixed States/layers affordance (_shared2/pm2-states.js: position:fixed, right:16px, bottom:34px, z-index:9000) painted on top of body copy. The previous central response only lowered its opacity, so the occlusion survived. Fixed here by shortening the SCROLL VIEWPORT instead of padding the content, so the dot sits outside the scroll box and no content can ever travel under it. Geometry measured at height 900: the statusbar is 24px in all eight themes and the dot's top edge is 66px above the viewport bottom, so it intrudes 42px into the stage; a 48px bottom border on the scroller clips the viewport 6px clear of it. Wide (stage >= 860px): the page sheet ends at the chapter spine and the dot lands on the spine, so '.c09-root:not(.is-narrow) .c09-spine' takes 'border-bottom: 48px solid transparent' - borders paint over the element's own background box, so the spine keeps its surface and nothing moves. Narrow (< 860px): the spine becomes a top strip and the whole page scrolls in the shell stage, so watchWidth() now stamps 'c09-stage-narrow' on #pmStage and '.pm-stage.c09-stage-narrow' takes 'border-bottom: 48px solid var(--surface)' - the same token the page sheet paints with, so the strip is indistinguishable from the sheet in every theme.
fixes.verified: Paint-level probe, two independent assertions. (1) elementFromPoint swept across the whole dot rect at 5 scroll offsets (0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 percent of every scrollable box on the page) for 900-home, 760-manager/m.providers, 1280-home, 1280-all, 1280-manager/m.providers and 2500-home: before the fix the sweep named page content at every offset (BUTTON.c09-chap-main 'Code & Execution', SPAN.c09-chap-desc, DIV.c09-card 'GitHub Copilot', SPAN.pm-status-word 'Signed in, cannot invoke'); after the fix it names only the scroller's own border area (MAIN.pm-stage.c09-stage-narrow at narrow, NAV.c09-spine at wide) at every offset. (2) Because a scroller's border area still names the root element, confirmed in pixels: screenshots with the dot hidden at 5 scroll offsets x 6 cases (friendly-dark-900-home, friendly-light-900-home, glass-dark-760-manager/m.providers, basic-light-760-all, friendly-dark-1280-manager/m.providers, retro-dark-2500-home) were decoded and the dot rect plus a 2px margin sampled: 1296-1656 pixels per rect, a single flat colour in every one (friendly-dark #2A2731 = --surface, friendly-light #FFFFFF, basic-light #EAECEF, glass-dark #291E40, retro-dark #202020), ink pixels 0, maximum channel delta 0 (1 in the glass gradient). A mid-scroll capture with the dot visible shows the chapter cards clipped cleanly above it and nothing beneath.

'.c09-root.is-narrow .c09-close' also takes margin-left:auto so that if a longer route ever does wrap, Close lands at the right edge where a page dismiss belongs.

findings: not-in-the-audit-packet (found by scrolling during this pass)
fixes.severity_note: functional: a reachable blank sheet at narrow widths
fixes.what: At narrow widths every route was laid out in an unbounded flex column, and on All Settings that made the 828-row virtual list unusable. .c09-canvas is a flex item of .c09-root, which turns to flex-direction:column below 860px of stage; the canvas set min-width:0 but not min-height:0, so its automatic minimum size along the (now vertical) main axis was its CONTENT height. The canvas therefore grew to fit everything it held, the layer sheet stopped being a bounded scroller, and the shell stage scrolled the whole document instead. On #/all the virtualized viewport expanded to its full 46,368px, and because the row window is sized from viewport.clientHeight at paint time it stayed at the 63 rows computed for the pre-layout height - so scrolling past roughly 3,500px of rows reached a blank sheet for the remaining ~43,000px. Fixed with min-height:0 on .c09-canvas (the vertical twin of the min-width:0 already there), which bounds every narrow route the same way the wide layout is bounded. A second, independent cause was fixed alongside it: paintWindow() sized the row window from viewport.clientHeight but scroll was its ONLY trigger, so any height change (narrow/wide flip, window resize, chat panel) left a window sized for the old height. The All Settings viewport now carries a ResizeObserver that repaints the window when its own height actually changes, rAF-throttled and guarded against feedback (the spacers live inside the viewport and cannot drive its flex-sized height).
fixes.verified: Bounding, all six probe routes at both narrow widths (760 and 900: home, dest/ai, manager/m.providers, all, copy, setting/system.health.platform-diagnostics): #pmStage now measures scrollHeight 788 == clientHeight 788 on every one - the shell stage no longer scrolls at all - with the canvas at 744 and the layer sheet the bounded scroller (clientHeight 744, scrollHeight 2024 / 5835 / 2209 / 836 / 999 / 4649). Before, 760 #/all measured stage clientHeight 788 / scrollHeight 46817 with .c09-all-viewport clientHeight 46460 and only 63 rows painted. Virtualization, measured by actually scrolling: the All Settings viewport is now clientHeight 431 / scrollHeight 46368 at 760 and 900 and clientHeight 603 / scrollHeight 46368 at 1280 (before at narrow: clientHeight 46460, scrollHeight 46460). Walking scrollTop to 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 90 / 100 percent at all three widths, the painted window advances every time (Theme -> Max Time Per Run -> Show Final Prompt Preview -> Allow Media Output -> Sort Skill List -> Graphics Engine .. Inspect Legal Holds) and painted rows cover 100 percent of the visible viewport band at every offset, including the last: 16 rows per window at narrow, 19 at 1280, 12-15 on the final partial window. No blank region is reachable. Resize repaint: 1280 -> 760 -> 1280 on a live page moves the window 19 -> 16 -> 19 rows at 100 percent coverage, including the stale-window trap of scrolling to 20,000px first and then narrowing. The States-dot clearance still holds on the new bounded narrow layout: dot-hidden screenshots at 4 scroll offsets x 5 cases (friendly-dark-900-home, glass-dark-760-manager/m.providers, basic-light-760-all, retro-light-900-dest/ai, friendly-dark-1280-all) decode to a single flat colour over the dot rect, ink 0, max channel delta 0 (1 in the glass gradient). The 760 All Settings mid-scroll capture that used to be an empty white sheet now shows a full window of Planning & Verification rows.
